reviews.title: Offline download vanished
reviews.text: Downloaded episodes disappear as soon as I enable airplane mode.

reviews.title: 无法离线播放
reviews.text: 节目显示已经下载，但断网后点击播放一直转圈。

reviews.title: Queue order changes
reviews.text: Adding one episode to Up Next silently rearranges the rest of my queue.

reviews.title: 播放列表顺序混乱
reviews.text: 我手动排好的播放顺序在重启应用后被重新排序。

reviews.title: Transcript drifts
reviews.text: The transcript is several sentences behind after changing playback speed to 1.5x.

reviews.title: 字幕不同步
reviews.text: 快进之后文字稿不会跟着当前音频位置更新。

reviews.title: Great discovery, noisy alerts
reviews.text: Recommendations are useful, but I get duplicate notifications for new episodes.

reviews.title: 重复通知
reviews.text: 同一期节目每次更新都会收到两到三条相同通知。

reviews.title: Sleep timer ignored
reviews.text: The sleep timer reaches zero but the next episode starts anyway.

reviews.title: 睡眠定时器失效
reviews.text: 设置十五分钟后停止，但节目结束后仍自动播放下一集。

reviews.title: Car controls lag
reviews.text: Steering-wheel skip controls take five seconds to respond over Bluetooth.

reviews.title: 车载控制延迟
reviews.text: 蓝牙连接汽车后，方向盘切换节目有明显延迟。
